Demo44 魔法学院 (まちがい召喚と、まほう学院の三人) — prompts for the layered art (DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §6 标准制作流程, §6.5) →
project/web_prompts.json for tools/openai/images.py (Seedance API upload probe 2026-11-09 01:10: 429, Retry-After 28,086 s → OpenAI per §5.3).

Characters = special versions of three for-men heroines (face, hair colour, personality, voice unchanged; outfit / hairstyle / identity
changed — docs/proposals/2026-11-08_crossover.md M1-West). References COPIED into assets/art/ (never linked, so nothing is written into
the original demos): ref_tsubaki (Demo25 tsubaki_torii = card lock_face) / ref_cocoa (Demo17 cocoa_welcome) / ref_luna (Demo19
luna_counter) + a closer face crop each (ref_<c>_close).
Step 1: two design options per character (design_<c>_a / _b, project/designs_contact.jpg) → picks 2026-11-09 (prepro, coordinator rule: pick yourself): Tsubaki A (academy uniform + crown braid), Cocoa A (leather apron, goggles on the beret, side braid), Luna B (witch's coat + hat: the biggest change, brim above the brows); the pick is copied to
<c>_base.png (the base pose). Step 2: the other poses reference the pick; blink variants are masked edits (face_points.json);
mouths = LivePortrait sets (free, tools/art/lp_mouths.py), so no talk variants are drawn.
Screens (guide §6 / card backdrop): all three on chroma GREEN #00B140 ("matte": "green"): silver-white Tsubaki, pastel Cocoa, Luna in
a navy robe (dark) — nothing green on any of them.
Run: python3 scripts/prompts.py

design_tsubaki_a.prompt:
Image 1 is the CHARACTER and STYLE reference: draw this exact young woman (her face, eyes, hair colour). Image 2 is the same woman closer (face reference).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: modern anime cel illustration (the same series), thin dark-lavender lineart, flat colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy, no bloom, not realistic, not 3D. Realistic adult proportions (not chibi), about 7 heads tall, a beautiful adult face.

Keep her FACE exactly as in images 1 and 2: the same eye shape, eye colour, eyebrows, nose, mouth, face shape and expression style — the same person, recognisable at once. Only her clothes and hairstyle change.

Tsubaki: the exact young woman from images 1-2 — very long silver-white hair, soft pink-red eyes, a gentle refined face, fair skin, a small RED CAMELLIA hair ornament (her anchor). Identity: a princess and top student of the academy's summoning class — polite, elegant, a little naive.

She now lives in an imaginary Western-fantasy kingdom with a royal academy of magic (storybook European, invented, not a real country or era): wool, velvet, leather, brass, embroidered crests, long cloaks. Nothing modern (no zips, no hoodies, no headphones, no plastic), no school-uniform sailor collar, not a Japanese kimono.

Outfit A: a white academy uniform with gold trim — fitted white jacket with gold buttons and a red camellia crest on the chest, a short white capelet with a gold clasp, a white pleated knee-length skirt, white gloves; a slim white wand with a gold tip in one hand. Hair A: her long silver-white hair partly braided into a CROWN BRAID around her head, the rest falling long down her back, the red camellia ornament at the side of the braid.

She stands facing the viewer, from the thighs up, centre, at eye level, holding the wand in front of her chest with both hands, a polite, slightly puzzled gentle smile. Mouth CLOSED.

Lighting on her: cool pale moonlight-blue light from above and warm torchlight from BOTH sides, soft and even.

Plain flat CHROMA-KEY GREEN background (#00B140), one even colour, completely empty: no scenery, no floor line, no shadow and no gradient on the background, no green anywhere on her. Her whole head and hair inside the frame with space above; her shoulders, arms and elbows not cut by the left or right picture edge (full figure inside the frame with margin at the sides). ONLY the character: no furniture, no cauldron, no table, no fire, no other people, no other hands.

Wide 16:9 game art. No text, no letters, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.
